urdu transliteration: Salaam baali Sakina, salaam dukhtar-e Husain
english translation text: Peace be upon Sakina(س), the little one of Husayn(ع)

urdu transliteration:
Sukoon-e Shaah-e Madina salaam ho tum par
Ae Karbala ki hazina salaam dukhtar-e Husain
Ghareeb-e Fatima nok-e sinaa se kehta hai
Rasan mein qaid yateema salaam ho tum par
english translation text:
Peace be upon you, O comfort of the King of Madina,
O sorrowful one of Karbala, daughter of Hussain(ع)
The lonely son of Fatimah, from the tip of the spear, calls out:
Peace be upon you, O orphaned child bound in chains.

urdu transliteration:
Salaam tum pe ae Shaah-e karam ki shehzadi
Salaam tum pe ae Ahl-e Haram ki shehzadi
Qadam qadam pe yeh Sajjad ro ke kehta hai
Salaam tum pe ae dard-o-alam ki shehzadi
english translation text:
Peace be upon you, O princess of the King of Generosity,
Peace be upon you, O princess of the Household of the Sanctuary.
At every step, Imam Sajjad(ع) weeps and says:
Peace be upon you, O princess of pain and suffering.

urdu transliteration:
Shabih-e Hazrat-e Zahra tujhe Nabi ka salaam
Andhere Shaam ke zindaan mein roshni ka salaam
Sada Najaf se musalsal yeh Shaam aati hai
Ae chaar saala zaeefa tujhe Ali ka salaam
english translation text:
O image of Lady Fatimah(س), the Prophet(ص) sends you his greetings.
In the darkness of Sham's prison, the Light sends you greetings.
A voice continually comes to Sham from Najaf, saying:
O frail little girl of four years, Ali(ع) sends you his greetings.

urdu transliteration:
Woh toq pehne yahi gaam gaam kehta hai
Salaam tujh ko ghamon ka Imaam kehta hai
Naheef o tashna o mazloom khawahar-e Sajjad (a)
Tujhe Nabi ka gharana salaam kehta hai
english translation text:
The one wearing the iron collar says at every step:
Peace be upon you—the Imam(ع) of sorrows sends you his greetings.
O weak, thirsty, and oppressed sister of Sajjad(ع),
The Household of the Prophet(ص) sends you the greetings.

urdu transliteration:
Salaam Shaam-o-sehar sheh pe rone wali par
Salaam surkhuru durun se hone wali par
Salaam uss pe jise maut ne sukoon bakhsha
Salaam Shaam ke zindaan mein sone wali par
english translation text:
Peace be upon the one who wept for the Shah(ع) day and night.
Peace be upon the one who emerged honored through suffering.
Peace be upon the one whom death finally granted peace.
Peace be upon the one who sleeps in the prison of Sham.

urdu transliteration:
Salaam teri lahd pe sada ujaalon ka
Salaam tujh pe sabhi dard ke hawalon ka
Ghuroob hote hue shams roz kehta hai
Salaam baali Sakina pe rone walon ka
english translation text:
Peace be upon your grave, forever illuminated.
Peace be upon you through every tale of pain and grief.
As the sun sets each day, it seems to say:
Peace be upon those who weep for little Sakina(س).
